name: services/groups/lecturer
description:
Get public list of groups lectured by given staff member. Public means, that you may
	anonymously access such activities of ALL staff members, you don't need their approval for this
	(teachers' schedules are publicly available).
brief_description: Get public list of groups lectured by given staff member.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of fields (as in the group method). Only primary fields are allowed.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Either pl or en - resulting list of groups will be sorted by the course name in the specified language.

arguments.name: active_terms
arguments.description: Return only these groups which are related to the currently active academic terms.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: The same as defined in participant method.
